description: This file is a shell script named size_compare.sh, which compares the sizes of OpenWrt packages locally against upstream versions. It reads configuration files, fetches package index data, computes size differences, and outputs a detailed comparison. It includes functions for help, package size calculation, and size comparison, and uses external tools like grep, sed, gzip, curl/wget, tar, and sort.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays the help message extracted from the script comments, showing usage instructions.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Calculates and outputs the size of a given package either from local files or upstream index, based on the 'CHECK_INSTALLED' setting.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Iterates over configured packages, compares local and upstream sizes, and outputs the size differences along with total change.
